scene_timeline.visual_description: Close-up of three cooked salmon fillets glazed with sauce and topped with sesame seeds and chives; a fork flakes a piece off.
scene_timeline.audio_description: This is the salmon of my dreams.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator mixes sriracha, mayonnaise, honey, and sesame oil in a white bowl.
scene_timeline.audio_description: In a bowl add sriracha and mayo, generous amounts of hot honey, a tiny bit of sesame oil and mix.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator shows a raw salmon fillet with skin, then seasons four fillets on a wire rack with salt and pepper.
scene_timeline.audio_description: I like skin on salmon fillets. Hefty pinch of salt, a dust of pepper.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator coats the salmon fillets in the sauce and arranges them in an air fryer basket.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Get each piece lost in the sauce. Make sure they're spaced out and beautiful like you. And into the air fryer at 400.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator presents the finished salmon on a plate, takes a large bite, and expresses satisfaction.
scene_timeline.audio_description: They only need like 10-12 minutes. And as always, bismillah. It's so simple but so delicious.

parsed_output.overall_summary: Ahmad Alzahabi (@thegoldenbalance) demonstrates a quick and easy recipe for Honey Sriracha Salmon. He prepares a glaze using sriracha, mayo, honey, and sesame oil, then seasons salmon fillets with salt and pepper. After coating the fish in the sauce, he air fries them at 400°F for approximately 10-12 minutes. The video concludes with him tasting the final product, emphasizing its simplicity and flavor.

takeaways.statement: Honey Sriracha Salmon is a simple yet delicious meal that can be prepared quickly in an air fryer.
Air frying salmon at 400°F for 10-12 minutes results in a perfectly cooked fillet.

items.name: Honey Sriracha Glaze
items.details: 1/4 cup sriracha, 1/4 cup mayo, 1/4 cup honey (or hot honey), 1 tsp sesame oil.

items.name: Salmon Preparation
items.details: 2lbs skin-on salmon fillets seasoned with salt and pepper to taste.

items.name: Cooking Instructions
items.details: Coat salmon in glaze. Air fry at 400°F for 10-15 minutes. Alternatively, oven bake at 425°F for similar time and finish with a broil.
